name: game-battle-log
description: Tool rows as an 8-bit battle log: HIT, CRIT (file changed), MISS with the error's first lines, BLOCK when a guard refused; failed tool groups unfold by themselves

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off leaves tool rows to the engine; casual draws short verdicts (HIT, MISS); hardcore draws game phrasing (CLAUDE의 BASH! … MISS…)
